original_en: Objects
translation_zh: 物品

original_en: Dagger\rMade with a reinforced\rtitanium steel blade, this\rdagger would be effective\rwhen used hand to hand\ragainst an opponent without\rarmor.
translation_zh: 匕首\r以強化鈦鋼刀刃製成，\r近戰對付無防護的敵人\r十分有效。

original_en: Sword\rWell balanced and highly\rdecorated, this sword can be\rused both in state ceremonies\ras well as in battle. It\rwould be highly lethal when\rused against an enemy without\rarmor.
translation_zh: 劍\r平衡良好且裝飾華麗，\r此劍可用於國家典禮\r亦可用於戰鬥。對\r無防護敵人致命。

original_en: Pistol\rMade for U.N.F.A. a security\rweapon, the Baretta 2043-UFS\ractually came into field\rservice in 2044 due to\rproblems with its loading\rsystem.  It fires a standard\rnine millimeter ammunition\rand is very effective at\rshort ranges.
translation_zh: 手槍\r為 U.N.F.A. 製造的安全\r武器，貝瑞塔 2043-UFS\r因供彈系統問題延至\r2044 年才服役。發射\r標準九毫米彈藥，近\r距離極具威力。

original_en: Rifle\rA hunter's weapon, this rifle\ris a long range weapon with\rfair accuracy. Although it is\rnot designed for combat\rsituations, it can be very\rdeadly in that capacity.
translation_zh: 步槍\r獵人的武器，此步槍\r為遠程武器，精準度\r尚可。雖非為戰鬥而\r設計，用於戰鬥仍能\r致命。

original_en: Assault Rifle\rWithout a doubt an assassin's\rweapon, this rifle fires high\rpower ammunition with laser\rfine accuracy.
translation_zh: 突擊步槍\r毫無疑問是刺客武器，\r發射高威力彈藥，\r雷射級的精準。

original_en: Machine Gun\rVery similar in design to\rU.N.F.A.'s hastily created\rG11-S, this machine gun fires\rcaseless rounds that can\rpenetrate most kinds of\rballistic armor. Like most\rmachine guns, it suffers from\ra very limited effective\rrange.
translation_zh: 機槍\r設計與 U.N.F.A. 倉促製\r造的 G11-S 極為相似，\r此機槍發射無殼彈，可\r貫穿多數彈道防護。如\r多數機槍，其有效射程\r十分有限。

original_en: Hand Laser\rThe innovative design of this\rhand laser is both functional\rand practical.  Using a\rcoiled heat damping system,\rthis weapon design allows\rlaser technology to be\reffective in a hand held\rsize.  It depends on\rammunition in the form of a\rpower cell.
translation_zh: 手持雷射\r此手持雷射的創新設計\r兼具功能與實用。採用\r盤繞式散熱系統，使雷\r射技術能在手持尺寸下\r發揮效用。其彈藥為動\r力電池。

original_en: Laser Rifle\rMore accurate than its hand\rheld counterpart, the laser\rrifle is designed for\rslightly heavier tasks which\rrequire more power in a\rlonger burst. In most\rgalactic societies, this has\rbecome the standard medium\rrange weapon.
translation_zh: 雷射步槍\r比手持型更為精準，雷\r射步槍是為較重型任務\r而設計，於更長爆發中\r提供更高威力。在多數\r星際社會中已成為標準\r中程武器。

original_en: Assault Laser\rCreated to deliver maximum\rdamage without suffering from\rthe dangers of medium ranged\ropposing fire, the Assault\rLaser has the best of both\rworlds and is a military\rissue weapon of choice.  Only\rthe very best of reflective\rarmors are useful against\rthis weapon.
translation_zh: 突擊雷射\r為了輸出最大傷害又避\r開中距交火危險而生，\r突擊雷射兼具兩者優\r勢，是軍方首選配發武\r器。唯有最頂級反射裝\r甲才能抵禦此武器。

original_en: Electron Gun\rThe fourth and least\reffective in a class of\r"sub-atomic" weapons, the\rElectron class gun creates\rinjuries by stripping the\relectrons from contacted\rmolecular structures, thereby\rseverely injuring any\runshielded targets.
translation_zh: 電子槍\r「次原子」武器系列中\r第四且威力最弱的，電\r子級槍藉由剝離接觸分\r子結構的電子造成傷\r害，可重創任何無護盾\r目標。

original_en: Neutron Gun\rThe third in the class of\r"sub-atomic" weapons, the\rNeutron Gun breaks down the\rmolecular integrity of its\rtarget by a barrage of very\rtightly focused neutrons.\rUnshielded targets are often\rseriously injured by these\rweapons.
translation_zh: 中子槍\r「次原子」武器系列第\r三件，中子槍以密集聚\r焦中子流瓦解目標的分\r子結構完整性。無護盾\r目標常被此武器重創。

original_en: Sub-Atomic Blaster\rLike the less developed\rmodels, the sub-atomic\rblaster combines the\rstrategies of electron and\rneutron guns and hits a\rtarget with much stronger\reffect.  In addition, the\rdesigners of the sub-atomic\rblaster have also solved the\rproblems of range and\raccuracy, improving on both\rcounts.
translation_zh: 次原子爆破槍\r如前代較不成熟的型\r號，此次原子爆破槍\r結合電子與中子槍的\r策略，能以更強效果擊\r中目標。此外，其設計\r者亦解決了射程與精準\r度的問題，雙雙改進。

original_en: Blue Quark Gun\rCode named project Blue\rQuark, this gun was a top\rsecret weapons development in\rSector Alnasl. Created by the\rOminar for a Dhoven\rcontractor, the Blue Quark\rGun is the first class\r"sub-atomic" weapon.  Firing\ran incredibly dense stream of\ranti-gluons into its target,\rthe gun comes close to\rcompletely disassembling\rthose unfortunate enough to\rfeel its effects.
translation_zh: 藍夸克槍\r代號「藍夸克」計畫，\r此槍為阿爾納斯星區\r的最高機密武器開發。\r由 Ominar 為 Dhoven 承\r包商打造，藍夸克槍是\r第一等的「次原子」武\r器。向目標發射極密的\r反膠子流，幾乎能完全\r拆解任何不幸感受其威\r力者。

original_en: Smart Gun\rA miniaturized artificial\rintelligence computer has\rbeen combined with a low\rgrade missile launcher to\rcreate this strategic weapon.\rMade to demoralize Scroe\rtroops on the battlefield,\rwhen fired the Smart Gun\rautomatically seeks out the\rstrongest enemy target.\rMorale among the enemy\rcollapses quickly in the face\rof this gun.
translation_zh: 智慧槍\r將微型人工智慧電腦\r與低階飛彈發射器結\r合而成的戰略武器。\r為打擊 Scroe 部隊士氣\r而造，發射時智慧槍會\r自動鎖定最強敵方目\r標。敵軍士氣在此武器\r面前迅速崩潰。

original_en: Grenade Launcher\rSimilar to those of\rtwentieth-century Earth, this\rgrenade launcher fires\rstandard fletchette type\rgrenades which affect a small\rarea of a few feet. Users\rshould be warned that it is\rpossible to be injured by\r'friendly fire' when using\rweapons of this sort.
translation_zh: 榴彈發射器\r與二十世紀地球的款式\r類似，此榴彈發射器發\r射標準飛鏢型榴彈，\r影響範圍數呎。使用者\r須注意此類武器可能\r造成「友軍火力」傷害。

original_en: Plasma Generator\rUsing very special designs,\rthis gun's developers\rsucceeded in creating a\rlocalized fuel-air explosion\rsimilar to those created by\rlarger fuel-air bombs.\rCreating intense heat\reffects, the plasma generator\roperates much like a\rlarge-scale flamethrower.
translation_zh: 電漿產生器\r採用極特殊的設計，\r開發者成功創造類似\r大型燃料空氣炸彈的\r局部燃料空氣爆炸。\r產生強烈熱效應，此\r電漿產生器運作有如\r大型火焰噴射器。

original_en: Seeker\rA counterpart to the Smart\rGun, the seeker gun also uses\rartificial intelligence and\rrocket launching technologies\rfor its affect. Not limited\rby a strict line of sight,\rthe seeker is capable of\rattacking targets around\rcorners and other\robstructions but does have a\rlimited range.
translation_zh: 追蹤者\r智慧槍的對應款，追蹤\r槍同樣運用人工智慧\r與火箭發射技術。不受\r嚴格視線限制，可攻擊\r轉角後或其他遮蔽物\r後的目標，但射程有\r限。

original_en: Acid Gun\rFiring small pellets of a\rhighly corrosive nature, the\racid gun is designed to\rdirectly attack the armor of\ran opponent.
translation_zh: 酸液槍\r發射高腐蝕性的小顆\r粒，酸液槍是為直接\r攻擊敵方護甲而設計。

original_en: Mono-Mol Disk Gun\rA projectile weapon, the\rmono-mol disk gun fires\rmolecule thick discs at a\rhigh rate of speed, allowing\rthem to penetrate most kinds\rof armor and do damage\rdirectly to the wearer. This\rweapon is highly unreliable,\rhowever, and is known to be\rvery vulnerable to\rTechJamming technologies.
translation_zh: 單分子盤槍\r一種投射武器，單分子\r盤槍高速發射僅分子\r厚度的圓盤，可貫穿多\r數護甲並對穿戴者造\r成直接傷害。然而此武\r器極不可靠，已知對技\r術干擾極為脆弱。

original_en: Defense Wave\rStrictly intended as a\rdefensive weapon, the defense\rwave propagator creates a\rglobular electrostatic burst\rthat is centered around the\ruser, doing damage to anyone\rand anything that stands in\rfront, behind or next to the\rdefender.  It is advised that\rthis item not be used in a\r'party' situation.
translation_zh: 防禦波\r嚴格屬於防禦性武器，\r防禦波散播器以使用\r者為中心產生球形靜\r電爆發，對守者前後左\r右的任何人事物造成\r傷害。建議勿於「隊\r伍」情境中使用。

original_en: Mass Cannon\rUtilizing mass driver\rtechnologies to deadly\reffect, this shoulder weapon\rfires a thousand gram\rprojectile from a short mass\rchamber at a velocity in\rexcess of nine hundred feet\rper second. Though it isn't\ralways capable of impaling\rall armor, it does\rsignificant damage while\rignoring any armored effects.
translation_zh: 質量砲\r運用質量驅動技術達\r到致命效果，此肩扛武\r器從短質量膛室以每\r秒超過九百呎的速度\r發射千克彈丸。雖未必\r能貫穿所有護甲，但能\r無視護甲造成可觀傷\r害。

original_en: Turbo Laser\rTermed by its inventor as a\r+suicide+ weapon, the turbo\rlaser fuses all of its\rcomponent parts as it fires\rits lethal burst. Effective\ronly at very short ranges,\rthese lasers are fatal to\rnearly anything that they\rtouch.
translation_zh: 渦輪雷射\r被發明者稱為「自殺式」\r武器，渦輪雷射發射致\r命爆發時會熔毀所有零\r件。僅在極近距離有\r效，此類雷射對接觸到\r的物體幾乎致命。

original_en: Cygnus Cannon\rAn inscription on the stock\rof the cygnus cannon gives\rall the details of the\rconstruction of this weapon\rof revenge.  Entirely unique\rin the galaxy, unmatched even\rby the technologies of the\rOminar or the Ipremi, the\rCygnus Cannon is capable of\rfiring a stream of stripped\rgravitons, in effect,\rcreating a pseudo-black hole\rin the center of its focal\rrange. When concentrated on\rany opponent, it will kill\rinstantly.
translation_zh: 天鵝座砲\r天鵝座砲的槍托上刻有\r此復仇武器全部建造細\r節的銘文。在銀河中獨\r一無二，連 Ominar 或\rIpremi 的技術亦無能\r及，天鵝座砲能發射一\r道剝離重力子流，在焦\r距中心造成偽黑洞。集\r中於任何對手時，可立\r即致死。

original_en: Chain Sword\rAn ingenuity created by the\rsettlers on Rutilicus Colony\rin Sector Kornephoros, the\rchain sword was created so\rthat settlers could have a\rdevice that would allow\rdefense against Cin-Sae Spawn\rwhile also having a device\rwith more practical purposes.
translation_zh: 鏈鋸劍\r庫尼弗洛斯星區魯提里\r克斯殖民地居民的巧\r思，鏈鋸劍的發明是為\r讓殖民者擁有可抵禦辛\r賽卵生族的器具，同時\r兼具更實用的用途。

original_en: Rocket Launcher\rModified from a basic grenade\rlaunch design, this rocket\rlauncher is a line of sight\rweapon capable of greater\rrange and damage than other\rsimilar weapons. Novices\rshould be warned that the\rweapon is as dangerous to\rfriendly parties as to\rhostile when used improperly.
translation_zh: 火箭發射器\r由基本榴彈設計改良，\r此火箭發射器為視線\r武器，比同類武器有更\r長射程與更高傷害。新\r手須注意此武器若使\r用不當，對友軍與敵軍\r同樣危險。

original_en: Death Ray\rA microwave transmitter has\rbeen coupled with a moderate\rpower supply in this simple\rhand held weapon. Aptly\rnamed, this death ray will\rkill most unarmored opponents.
translation_zh: 死光\r微波發射器與中等電\r源耦合於此簡易手持\r武器中。名符其實，此\r死光能殺死多數無甲\r的對手。

original_en: Microtic Injector\rStealing technology developed\rfor the needler guns, the\rMicrotic Injector is a\rhypervelocity injection\rsystem which introduces a\rmicrotic army into the body\rof an opponent. Once\rinside,microts then attack\rwhatever systems they\rencounter until their power\rsupplies fail. Also a good\rdevice for injecting\rStrandware into a host.
translation_zh: 微體注射器\r盜用針槍研發的技術，\r微體注射器是高速注\r射系統，將微體大軍\r送入敵人體內。微體進\r入後，便會攻擊所遇到\r的所有系統，直到能量\r耗盡。亦是注入鏈件\r至宿主的優良裝置。

original_en: Tac Nuke Rifle\rOperating more like a rocket\rlauncher than a rifle, this\rweapon fires a\rmicro-miniature fissionable\rcharge into a specified zone.\rOnce there it detonates with\ra titanic blast. Victims\rsuffer both radiation and\rprojectile damage.
translation_zh: 戰術核彈槍\r運作更像火箭發射器\r而非步槍，此武器向\r指定區域發射微型可\r裂變彈頭。一旦抵達\r便以巨大爆炸引爆。\r受害者同時承受輻射\r與彈片傷害。

original_en: Breach Missile\rUsing highly complex armor\rpiercing techniques, this\rmissile launcher does all of\rits damage against any armor\rit encounters, in most cases\rmaking it possible for a\rsecondary attack to do real\rdamage.
translation_zh: 破甲飛彈\r運用高度複雜的穿甲\r技術，此飛彈發射器\r將所有傷害施加於遇\r到的任何裝甲，使二\r次攻擊得以造成實質\r傷害。

original_en: Needler\rThis handgun, designed to\rfool Evian Interceptor Armor,\rfires fletched needles which\rspread into a dense cloud\rshortly before they impact.
translation_zh: 針槍\r此手槍為了騙過 Evian 攔\r截裝甲而設計，發射帶\r尾翼的針，撞擊前會散\r開成密集針雲。

original_en: Imastyl\rEssentially a handless\rdagger, the Imastyl has a\rnumber of ritualistic\rpurposes to the people of\rHenresia. They Who Converse\rare said to use the Imastyl\rto draw the pictures that\rthey use to communicate with\rone another.
translation_zh: 伊馬斯堤\r基本上是無柄的匕首，\r對 Henresia 人有諸多儀\r式用途。據說「交談\r者」會用伊馬斯堤畫\r出彼此溝通用的圖像。

original_en: Energy Mace\rTactically a very cruel\rweapon, the energy mace does\rmost of its damage when the\rvictim is struck by its five\rhundred gram head. A second\rfeature, an electric shock of\r8000 volts, is delivered to\rthe victim at the same time\rin order to further disable\rthe enemy.
translation_zh: 能量錘\r戰術上極其殘忍的武\r器，能量錘的大部分傷\r害來自其五百克重的\r錘頭。第二項特性是同\r時對受害者施加 8000\r伏特的電擊，以進一步\r癱瘓敵人。

original_en: Thermite Launcher\rTaking advantage of the\rsimilarity of the grenade\rlaunchers made by the traders\rin Sector Algieba, the Ethnys\rcreated the Thermite\rLauncher, a weapon that\rbathes its targets in flame.
translation_zh: 鋁熱劑發射器\r利用 Algieba 星區商人\r所製榴彈發射器的相\r似性，Ethnys 製造了\r鋁熱劑發射器，能將\r目標浸沒於火焰中的\r武器。

original_en: Scroe Special\rThe so-called 'scroe-special'\ris in fact a substandard\rpistol that fires caseless\rrounds. Usually only used by\rthe Scroe for purposes of\rinternal security, it\rsometimes is sold on the open\rmarket. This particular model\rappears to be in very poor\rshape.
translation_zh: Scroe 特製\r所謂「Scroe 特製」其實\r是不達標的手槍，發射\r無殼彈。通常只供 Scroe\r內部安全使用，偶爾流\r入公開市場。這一把看\r來狀況非常差。

original_en: Battle Laser\rSlighty heavier than an\rAssault Laser, the Battle\rLaser is very long ranged but\rsacrifices a significant\rdegree of its punch to make\rthe range possible. Weapons\rof this sort have reduced the\rnecessity of short range\rbattles that have been\rdictated by shorter ranged\rlaser weapons.
translation_zh: 戰鬥雷射\r比突擊雷射稍重，戰\r鬥雷射射程極遠但為\r了換得射程而犧牲了\r相當程度的威力。此\r類武器降低了由短射\r程雷射武器主宰的近\r距離戰鬥之必要性。

original_en: Sossee Dagger\rStrictly a ceremonial weapon,\rthis dagger is greatly\rrevered as a holy symbol.\rUsed in mystery rites for\rages, it now tours\rperiodically as an art\robject. HabStel on Starport\rKochab has reportedly bid\rlarge sums to gain possession\rof the dagger but have so far\rbeen unsucessful.
translation_zh: Sossee 匕首\r純粹為儀式用武器，\r此匕首被視為神聖象\r徵備受敬重。多年來\r用於神秘儀式，現以\r藝術品身分定期巡迴\r展出。據傳 Kochab 太\r空港的 HabStel 曾出鉅\r款欲取得，至今未果。

original_en: Laser Sword\rPulsed bursts of laser energy\rare used to create the\r+blade+ of this curious item.\rAlthough it has several\rredeeming features, it\rsuffers from great\rsusceptibility to TechJam and\ris somewhat unwieldy to those\runused to using such an\relaborate weapon.
translation_zh: 雷射劍\r以脈衝式雷射能量爆\r發形成此奇特物品的\r「劍刃」。雖有數項可\r取之處，但對技術干\r擾極為敏感，且對不\r熟悉此類精巧武器者\r來說有些難以駕馭。

original_en: Plasma Bow\rThis weapon combines the\rgrace of archaic weaponry\rwith the destructive power of\rmodern technology. The plasma\rbow shoots concentrated bolts\rof plasma energy that strike\rand burn their target. A\rgreat deal of damage is done\ragainst foes not wearing\rarmor.
translation_zh: 電漿弓\r此武器融合古代兵器\r的優雅與現代科技的\r破壞力。電漿弓發射\r凝聚的電漿能量箭矢，\r擊中並燒灼目標。對\r未穿護甲的敵人造成\r大量傷害。

original_en: Super Laser\rThe most powerful of the\rlaser weapons, the Super\rLaser operates at the long\rrange of the Battle Laser\rwithout sacrificing\rdestructive capabilities.
translation_zh: 超級雷射\r雷射武器中威力最強，\r超級雷射在戰鬥雷射\r的長射程下運作，不\r犧牲破壞能力。

original_en: Atomizer\rThe atomizer delivers a\rfocused beam of x-ray\rradiation that is able to \rpenetrate most normal types\rof armor. Not very effective\ragainst archaic armor.
translation_zh: 霧化器\r霧化器發射一束聚焦\rX 射線輻射，能穿透\r多數常規護甲。對古\r代護甲效果不彰。

original_en: Leather Armor\rBeautifully tooled, this\rleather armor should be able\rto turn back the blades of\rdaggers and reduce damage\rfrom conventional swords.
translation_zh: 皮甲\r雕工精美的皮甲，應\r能擋下匕首的刀刃並\r減輕一般劍類的傷害。

original_en: Chain Mail\rThousands of wrought iron\rrings have been linked\rtogether to form this superb\rsuit of low-tech armor.\rCapable of stopping daggers\rand swords, it is still\rvulnerable to penetration by\rarrows and other projectile\rweapons.
translation_zh: 鎖子甲\r數千個熟鐵環相連而\r成的精良低科技護甲。\r可擋下匕首與劍，但\r仍易遭弓箭及其他投\r射武器穿透。

original_en: Plate Mail\rPolished to a shine, this\rplate mail is astonishingly\rsimilar to the plate mail\rfound on Earth during its\rmedieval period. Although it\rwould be poorly matched\ragainst firearms, it should\rstop any less severe kind of\rprojectile attack.
translation_zh: 板甲\r擦得發亮的板甲，與\r地球中世紀時期的板\r甲驚人地相似。雖然\r難以對抗火器，但仍\r能擋下較輕微的投射\r攻擊。

original_en: Flak Jacket\rA fairly heavy form of armor,\rthe flak jacket is designed\rto stop small arms fire at\rshort range. Heavier\rprojectile weapons may still\rpenetrate the skin of this\rarmor.
translation_zh: 防彈背心\r頗為厚重的護甲，防\r彈背心是為阻擋近距\r離輕武器射擊而設計。\r較重型投射武器仍可\r穿透其表面。

original_en: Kevlar Suit\rNot so heavy as the standard\rflak jacket, the Kevlar Suit\ris far better suited to\ractual combat situations and\rallows greater freedom of\rmovement. Capable of\rwithstanding heavy arms fire\rat moderate ranges, this is\rthe basic armor that most\rlow-tech societies use for\rthe protection of their\rmilitaries.
translation_zh: 克維拉套裝\r不像標準防彈背心那\r樣厚重，克維拉套裝\r更適合實戰情境，並\r允許更大的活動自由\r度。能抵擋中距離的\r重武器射擊，是多數\r低科技社會用以保護\r其軍隊的基本護甲。

original_en: Composite Armor\rCombining lightweight\rconstruction and high stress\rflexibility, this armor is\rcapable of withstanding small\rand moderate arms fire while\rit is still in good\rcondition. Elite officers are\roften issued this armor.
translation_zh: 複合裝甲\r結合輕量構造與高應\r力撓性，此護甲在狀\r態良好時可抵擋輕型\r與中型武器射擊。常\r配發給精銳軍官。

original_en: Reflec Armor\rPitted with thousands of\rsmall parabolic reflectors,\rthis is a high tech armor\rdesigned to shed the\rdevastating effects of small\rlaser fire. Larger scale\rlasers are capable of eating\rquickly through this armor.
translation_zh: 反射裝甲\r鑲嵌數千個小型拋物\r面反射鏡，此為高科\r技護甲，旨在化解小\r型雷射射擊的毀滅效\r果。大型雷射仍能迅\r速貫穿此裝甲。

original_en: Ceramic Armor\rLess vulnerable than reflec\rarmor, ceramic armor can\rwithstand great heat before\rsuccumbing to the effects of\rlaser fire. Wearers should be\radvised, however that a\rprojectile weapon could still\reasily breach such armor.
translation_zh: 陶瓷裝甲\r比反射裝甲更不易受\r損，陶瓷裝甲在雷射\r射擊效果擊潰它之前\r可承受高熱。穿戴者\r須注意投射武器仍能\r輕易突破此類護甲。

original_en: Evian Armor\rDuring the vicious years of\rthe Attrition Conflict, the\rEvians developed this\rfrightening looking black\rarmor as a defense against\rthe rapid-fire weapons\rwielded by the Scroe trench\rarmies. Utilizing a special\rpair of lasers attached to\rthe shoulders of the armor,\rincoming projectiles are\rautomatically vaporized as\rthey approach until the\rsuit's power supply is\rexhausted.
translation_zh: Evian 裝甲\r在消耗衝突的殘酷歲\r月中，Evian 人開發出\r這套外表駭人的黑色\r裝甲，用以對抗 Scroe\r壕溝部隊所持的速射\r武器。藉由肩部裝設\r的一對特殊雷射，靠\r近的彈體會被自動氣\r化，直到套裝電力耗\r盡為止。

original_en: Personal Shield\rThis force-field based armor\ris capable of shedding both\rlaser and 'sub-atomic' fire,\rbut has a relatively low\rbreach value.
translation_zh: 個人護盾\r以力場為基礎的護甲，\r可同時化解雷射與\r「次原子」攻擊，但破\r防值相對較低。

original_en: Modu-Armor\rThis is an active armor\rdesigned to stop 'sub-\ratomic' damage to the wearer.\rBy creating a modulating\rvirtual wall of neutrons\raround the wearer, it endows\rthe ability to see a target\rwhile still providing a solid\rshield around them. If it\rreceives more damage than it\rcan vent, the field will then\rfall apart.
translation_zh: 調變裝甲\r主動式護甲，旨在阻\r擋穿戴者所受的「次\r原子」傷害。藉由在\r穿戴者周圍生成可調\r變的虛擬中子牆，賦\r予其觀測目標之能力，\r同時提供堅固護盾。\r若所受傷害超過其耗\r散能力，力場便會崩\r潰。

original_en: May Field\rDeveloped by Ageus May, this\renergy field has proven to be\rthe most effective armor\ragainst 'sub-atomic' attack.\rBy generating a field of\rgluons around the wearer,\rthis field effectively sheds\rneutron and electron class\rguns. As with the other types\rof 'sub-atomic' armors, it\rstands a chance of\roverloading and imploding on\rits wearer.
translation_zh: 梅伊力場\r由 Ageus May 開發，此\r能量場已證實為對抗\r「次原子」攻擊最有\r效的護甲。藉由在穿\r戴者周圍生成膠子場，\r能有效化解中子與電\r子級槍械。如其他「\r次原子」護甲一樣，\r有過載並向穿戴者內\r爆的風險。

original_en: Admantine Chain\rThis chain mail is the very\rfinest armor that is possible\rwithin a low-tech society.\rCapable of stopping even\rarrows and small arms fire,\rthis chain is the finest in\rany class of armor.
translation_zh: 精鋼鎖甲\r此鎖子甲是低科技社\r會所能造出的最頂級\r護甲。連箭矢與輕武\r器射擊都能擋下，是\r此類護甲中最頂尖的。

original_en: Teflar Suit\rHighly heat resistant and\rflexible, laser and\rprojectile weaponry are\rchallenged to breach the skin\rof this suit. It is still\rmoderately vulnerable to\r'sub-atomic' attack.
translation_zh: 鐵弗龍套裝\r極耐高溫且具柔軟性，\r雷射與投射武器難以\r破壞此套裝的表層。\r但對「次原子」攻擊\r仍有中度脆弱性。

original_en: Assault Suit\rHighly expensive and greatly\rvalued, this armor was\rcreated by the Ominar for\rtheir defense troops on the\rborders of their territories.\rResistant to all types of\rattack, this suit has a high\rbreach value and can\rwithstand most heavy weapons\rfire.
translation_zh: 突擊套裝\r極為昂貴且備受看重，\r此護甲為 Ominar 為其\r邊境防守部隊製造。\r對所有攻擊類型皆有\r抗性，破防值高，可\r承受多數重武器射擊。

original_en: Recon Armor\rMade with the same defenses\ras the Assault Suit, Recon\rArmor was scaled down to\rallow more suits to be made\rwhile cutting costs.\rAlthough its breach value was\rsacrificed, it gained special\rmechanised features which\rallows the wearer to smash\rthrough thin walls. Despite\rits bulky mass, it is still\rquite adequate in battle\rsituations.
translation_zh: 偵察裝甲\r與突擊套裝具相同防\r護，偵察裝甲為了量\r產並削減成本而縮減\r規模。雖犧牲了破防\r值，但獲得特殊機械\r功能，使穿戴者可撞\r穿薄牆。雖然體積龐\r大，於戰鬥情境中仍\r相當合用。

original_en: Shielded Reflec\rThis special class of reflec\rarmor is designed for\rreconnaissance purposes so\rthat scouting parties stand a\rmoderate chance of survival\rwhen they are unsure of an\renemy's armament. Although\rit is not recommended for\rsustained battles, it is a\rvery good armor for hit and\rrun missions.
translation_zh: 護盾反射甲\r此特殊類型的反射裝\r甲為偵察用途而設計，\r使偵察隊在不確定敵\r方武裝時有適度存活\r機會。雖不建議用於\r持久戰，但對於打了\r就跑的任務是非常好\r的護甲。

original_en: Dreadnaught Suit\rThe Dreadnaught Suit is the\rtoughest armor available in\rthe known galaxy. It offers\rthe greatest protection \ragainst most weapons.
translation_zh: 無畏套裝\r無畏套裝是已知星系\r中最堅固的護甲。對\r多數武器提供最大限\r度的保護。

original_en: Escape Code\rA thin plastic card with the\rwords 'Escape Code' written\rin the language of the\rOminar. Tiny bumps on the\rsurface of the card form an \rintricate pattern.
translation_zh: 逃脫密碼\r一張薄塑膠卡，上面\r以 Ominar 語寫著「逃\r脫密碼」。卡面上的\r小凸起構成複雜的圖\r樣。

original_en: K-Beam\rOne of the eight pieces of\rthe Centauri Device.  The\rK-Beam generator creates a\rselectively permeable wall of\rpositrons designed to prevent\runwanted matter from coming\rthrough the wormhole.
translation_zh: K光束\r半人馬裝置的八件之\r一。K光束產生器形\r成可選擇性穿透的正\r電子牆，用以阻止不\r想要的物質穿過蟲洞。

original_en: Harmonic Resonator\rOne of the eight pieces of\rthe Centauri Device.  The\rHarmonic Resonator generates\rgravity waves in the patterns\rneccessary to open the\rwormhole.
translation_zh: 諧振共振器\r半人馬裝置的八件之\r一。諧振共振器產生\r開啟蟲洞所需特定模\r式的重力波。

original_en: Omega Card\rA thin plastic card with a \rrepresentation of the Alkaid\rsystem engraved on it.
translation_zh: 歐米茄卡\r薄塑膠卡，上面雕刻\r著 Alkaid 星系的圖樣。

original_en: Silver Locket\rA filigreed silver locket in\rthe shape of a royal seal.
translation_zh: 銀色墜飾\r精雕的銀色墜飾，造\r型如皇室印璽。

original_en: Key Card\rDesigned to be used with\rmagnetic door locks, this key\rcard is backed with a thin\rferrous- sensitive tape.
translation_zh: 鑰匙卡\r為搭配磁性門鎖而設\r計，此鑰匙卡背面有\r一條薄薄的磁感應帶。

original_en: Algiebian Crystal\rThese crystals have\rtremendous value as power\rsources.  When excited in a\rwarp field, the Algiebian\rCrystals emit a singularly\rcomplex wave which can be\ramplified by a Mass\rConverter. This is one of the\reight pieces of the Centauri\rDevice.
translation_zh: 阿吉比安水晶\r這些水晶作為能源具\r有巨大價值。在曲速\r場中受激時，阿吉比\r安水晶會發出一種獨\r特的複雜波，可由質\r量轉換器放大。為半\r人馬裝置八件之一。

original_en: Algiebian Quarter\rThe face of this Algiebian\rcoin is stamped with the\rimage of Ishtao, president of\rthe Algiebian Empire.\rAlthough coinage has largely\rgone out of use within their\rsystems, they still use coins\rfor vending purposes.
translation_zh: 阿吉比安銀角\r此阿吉比安硬幣正面\r鑄有阿吉比安帝國總\r統 Ishtao 的肖像。雖\r然其星系內硬幣大致\r已不再流通，但仍用\r於販賣機購物。

original_en: Kochab-Cola\rBitter tasting and dark, it\rseems remarkable that this\rsoft drink would be popular\rin any sector of the galaxy.\rIt is particularly favored by\rthe Algiebians.
translation_zh: Kochab 可樂\r味苦色深，這種飲料\r竟能在任何星區受歡\r迎實在令人驚訝。阿\r吉比安人尤其喜愛。

original_en: Newspaper\rThe newspaper is filled with\rthe usual tabloid fare.\rLIZARDESS WOMAN GIVES LIVE\rBIRTH! graces its cover, but\runder it is a story about the\rGeal A'nai. The cult has\rreportedly been hijacking\rships in the system.
translation_zh: 報紙\r報紙充滿典型小報內\r容。「蜥蜴女產活胎！」\r占據封面，下方則是\r一則關於 Geal A'nai 的\r報導。該教團據傳一\r直在劫持本星系內的\r船艦。

original_en: Vegan Wine\rPressed by the Ominar, Vegan\rwine has a number of unusual\rproperties. Known to be very\rintoxicating, it is largely\rprohibited in many societies.
translation_zh: 織女座葡萄酒\r由 Ominar 釀造，此酒\r具有諸多不尋常特性。\r以強烈醉人著稱，於\r多數社會中均屬禁品。

original_en: Press Pass\rThe press pass bears the\rmasthead logo of the "Nightly\rStalker", the only state\rfunded newspaper on Algieba.
translation_zh: 媒體通行證\r此通行證印有「夜行\r者報」的報頭標誌，\r是阿吉比安唯一一份\r國家資助的報紙。

original_en: Geal A'nai Amulet\rA deeply religious people,\rmany of the Algiebians belong\rto a monastic order known as\rthe Geal A'nai. This amulet\ris often recognized as being\rthe sign of their faith.
translation_zh: Geal A'nai 護符\r阿吉比安人虔誠信仰，\r許多人屬於一個名為\rGeal A'nai 的修道團體。\r此護符常被視為他們\r信仰的象徵。

original_en: Sixth Seal\rSuspended on a chain, the\rSixth Seal is one of five\rsuch amulets that is said to\rhave mystical powers.  The\rSixth is markedly different\rin that it has a key-like\rextrusion at its top which\rallows it to open locks that\rhave been made by the Geal\rA'nai.
translation_zh: 第六印\r以鏈條垂掛，第六印\r是傳說具有神秘力量\r的五件護符之一。第\r六印明顯不同之處在\r於頂端有類似鑰匙的\r凸起，可開啟 Geal A'nai\r所製的鎖。

original_en: President's Amulet\rTraditionally passed from one\rTorm to the next, the amulet\ris now a symbol of the\rrightful leader of the\rAlgiebian people. Many\rreligious leaders say that\rthe amulet grants its bearer\rgreat luck.
translation_zh: 總統的護符\r傳統上由前後任 Torm\r相傳，此護符如今是\r阿吉比安人正統領導\r者的象徵。許多宗教\r領袖稱此護符能賜給\r持有者好運。

original_en: Security Card\rStriped with a bar code on\rthe back, this card allows a\rbearer to enter any door on\rthe Presidential Station in\rorbit of Algieba IV.
translation_zh: 安全卡\r背面有條碼，此卡可\r讓持有者進入阿吉比\r安四號軌道上總統艦\r站的任一道門。

original_en: Algiebian Tal\rThe primary unit of monetary\rexchange within the confines\rof the Algiebian Empire, the\rTal is made of solid gold.\rDespite the inflation that\rruns rampant in the sector,\rthe Tal may still be used for\rthe purchase of wines and\rother necessities.
translation_zh: 阿吉比安泰爾\r阿吉比安帝國境內的\r主要貨幣單位，泰爾\r由純金鑄成。儘管星\r區內通膨猖獗，泰爾\r仍可用於購買酒類及\r其他必需品。

original_en: Visitor Badge\rGrants to the bearer\rvisitation rights to the\rSabik Mining Colony in Sector\rKornephoros.
translation_zh: 訪客徽章\r給予持有者參訪庫尼\r弗洛斯星區 Sabik 礦業\r殖民地的權利。

original_en: Industrial Badge\rThis card identifies the\rholder as a trading agent for\rthe Sabik Mining Colony.\rAllows greater visitation\rrights than those granted by\rthe Visitor's Badge.
translation_zh: 工業徽章\r此卡證明持有者為 Sabik\r礦業殖民地的貿易代\r理人。比訪客徽章授\r予更大的參訪權限。

original_en: Sector Clearance Card\rThe Sector Clearance Card is\rmade of a crystaline material\rpermeated with gossamer veins\rof green conduit.  It contains\rall the information necessary\rto fool the communication\rcomputers on Eltanin VII thus\rallowing you authorized access\rfor terminal use.
translation_zh: 星區通行卡\r星區通行卡由結晶材\r質製成，內部布滿綠\r色細絲導管。包含足\r以騙過 Eltanin VII 通訊\r電腦的全部資訊，使\r你獲得使用終端機的\r授權存取。

original_en: Skocha Roots\rAn odd clump of vegetable\rmatter, these roots have a\rmild juice in them that is\rusually consumed by Danteans\rto shield them from the\reffects of severe radiation.
translation_zh: Skocha 根\r一團奇怪的植物，此\r根含有溫和的汁液，\rDantean 人常飲用以保\r護自身免受強烈輻射\r影響。

original_en: Pikor\rA mining implement, the Pikor\ris used on several colonies\rin the local group.  A good\rtool for removing boulders\rthat block your path.
translation_zh: 皮可鏟\r一種採礦工具，皮可\r鏟在本群域多處殖民\r地使用。是清除擋路\r巨石的好工具。

original_en: Bag Of Diamonds\rA common form of galactic\rexchange, there appear to be\rseveral diamonds of value in\rthis bag.  They are\respecially favored by the\rEthnys and Utreceian races.
translation_zh: 一袋鑽石\r星際間的通用交易媒\r介，這袋中似有數顆\r具價值的鑽石。Ethnys\r與 Utreceian 族尤其偏好。

original_en: Blast Wear\rMade to protect the wearer\rfrom intense heat and\renvironmental conditions,\rblast wear is a necessary\ritem for people to wear on\rthe surface of Sabik.
translation_zh: 防爆服\r為保護穿戴者免受高\r熱與環境影響而設計，\r防爆服是人們在 Sabik\r表面活動的必備裝備。

original_en: Infra Specs\rDesigned to make infra\rencoded messages visible,\rthese goggles are commonly\rused in the Kornephoros\rsector.
translation_zh: 紅外線眼鏡\r為將紅外線編碼訊息\r轉為可見而設計，此\r護目鏡常用於庫尼弗\r洛斯星區。

original_en: Prong\rThis peculiar object appears\rto have been broken off of\rsome larger object.  Whatever\rfunction it once served, it\rwould seem to be useless now.
translation_zh: 尖叉\r這個奇怪的物品似乎\r是從更大的物品上斷\r落的。不論它曾有何\r功用，現在看來毫無\r用處。

original_en: Doorspiker\rThis triple pronged key was\rspecially made to fit the\rhands of the Dantean race. An\rinscription code on the\rhandle of the key suggests\rthat it unlocks a door on\rSabik Mining Colony.
translation_zh: 門鎖鑽\r此三叉鑰匙特別為配\r合 Dantean 族的手而製。\r鑰匙柄上的銘刻碼暗\r示它可開啟 Sabik 礦業\r殖民地的某道門。

original_en: ComNav Sq 2345-8.\rThe design of this electronic\rpart would seem to suggest\rthat it is used as a warp\rfield stabilizer for cargo\rclass ships. Although it is\runsuitable for Earth designs,\rit might have value to\rtraders in Sector Caroli.
translation_zh: ComNav Sq 2345-8\r此電子零件的設計顯\r示它用作貨運級船艦\r的曲速場穩定器。雖\r然不適用地球設計，\r但對 Caroli 星區的商\r人或許有價值。

original_en: Gold Wire\rFused at the ends, this\rbroken piece of wire may have\rmelted loose from a larger\rsection of cable. If it is\rused to reconnect the circuit\rit once serviced, it might\rdistract any Microtic\ractivity nearby.
translation_zh: 金線\r兩端熔合，此斷線可\r能是從較大段電纜上\r熔斷脫落。若用以重\r新接通它曾屬之電路，\r或能擾亂附近的微體\r活動。

original_en: Logic Circuit Alpha\rThis circuit is the main\rcontrol gate for the\roperation of a Gravitic\rCompressor. If a Beta class\rcircuit is swapped for it, it\rmay cause a reversal of the\rcompression field.
translation_zh: 阿爾法邏輯電路\r此電路為重力壓縮器\r運作的主控閘。若以\r貝塔級電路替換，可\r能造成壓縮場反轉。

original_en: Logic Circuit Beta\rThis circuit, when used as a\rsecondary circuit, controls\rminor logic functions. When\rplaced in an Alpha Logic\rtower, it will reverse a\rminiaturization field.
translation_zh: 貝塔邏輯電路\r此電路作為次級電路\r時控制次要邏輯功能。\r若置入阿爾法邏輯塔\r中，將反轉微型化場。

original_en: Strand Viewer\rIf used on Ominar strandware,\rthis device can allow close\rscrutiny of the condition of\rthe material.  It is commonly\rused to sort good strandware\rfrom bad.
translation_zh: 鏈件檢視器\r若用於 Ominar 鏈件，\r此裝置可近距離檢視\r材料狀態。常用於分\r辨良品與劣品。

original_en: Gravitic Compressor\rOne of the eight vital parts\rto the Centauri Device, the\rGravitic Compressor is used\ras the focusing device for\rthe titanic forces that are\rgenerated when the K-Beam is\ractivated.
translation_zh: 重力壓縮器\r半人馬裝置八件關鍵\r零件之一，重力壓縮\r器用作 K 光束啟動時\r所生巨大力量的聚焦\r裝置。

original_en: Requisition Form\rSigned by the chief\rcontroller of the Harvest\rtraffic controller team, this\rrequisition form is filled\rout to the chief engineer of\rOortizam Labs. It still\rappears to need a proper\rcounter signature from the\rOminarian director of the\rOortizam Lab.
translation_zh: 申請單\r由 Harvest 交通管制隊的\r首席管制員簽署，這份\r申請單填給 Oortizam 實\r驗室的總工程師。但仍\r需 Oortizam 實驗室的\rOminarian 主任會簽。

original_en: Authorized Form\rThe form appears to be\rproperly signed and noted. It\rcan be exchanged at the\rEngineering lab on Ooritzam\rfor a ComNav Sq 2345-8.
translation_zh: 已核准表單\r表單看來已正確簽署\r並註記。可於 Ooritzam\r的工程實驗室兌換一\r個 ComNav Sq 2345-8。

original_en: Mini-Lab Pass\rThis card will allow the\rbearer access to the\rminiaturization lab on\rOoritzam.
translation_zh: 迷你實驗室通行證\r此卡允許持有者進入\rOoritzam 的微型化實驗室。

original_en: Generator\rGasoline fueled, this\rgenerator appears to be very,\rvery old. With some\rmaintenance it might be\rcapable of sustaining a small\rstation's power needs.
translation_zh: 發電機\r以汽油為燃料，這台\r發電機看來非常非常\r老舊。經過些許維修\r或許還能滿足小型站\r點的電力需求。

original_en: Sonic Pincers.\rAn alien analogue to pliers,\rthese sonic pincers appear to\rhave had some rugged use.
translation_zh: 聲波鉗\r類似鉗子的異星工具，\r此聲波鉗看來經過粗\r暴使用。

original_en: Blo\rMade of a dark, reedlike\rmaterial, the Blo is a\rmusical instrument\rmanufactured by the Nuskuan\rrace as a morbid amusement.\rAlthough many modern blos are\rmade from plastic,\rtraditional craftsmen still\rmake them from the appendages\rthat the pre-mature Nuskuans\rshed before becoming adults.
translation_zh: 布洛笛\r以暗色蘆葦狀材料製\r成，布洛笛是 Nuskuan\r族製造的樂器，作為\r一種病態娛樂。雖然\r現代布洛笛多以塑膠\r製成，傳統工匠仍以\r未成年 Nuskuan 蛻變\r前所脫落的附肢製作。

original_en: Captain's NoteBook\rA notebook that is used for\rtaking notes.
translation_zh: 艦長的筆記本\r用來作筆記的本子。

original_en: Thermaul\rA special form of shovel, the\rthermaul is made for digging\rthrough hard packed layers of\rice and snow.  Enhanced with\ra heated, vibrating tip, it\ris the single most important\rtool for those living on icy\rworlds.
translation_zh: 熱鏟\r一種特殊形式的鏟子，\r熱鏟為挖掘堅實的冰\r雪層而製。配有加熱\r振動的尖端，是冰雪\r世界居民最重要的工\r具。

original_en: Algiebian Invite\rThis invitation will admit a\rparty of visitors to the\rinaugural festivities that\rare underway at Algieba IV.
translation_zh: 阿吉比安邀請函\r此邀請函可讓一隊訪\r客進入阿吉比安四號\r正在舉行的就職慶典。

original_en: Talking Stick\rHollowed from a very large\rlog, the talking stick is a\rceremonial symbol of the\runity of the Henresian\rpeople.  It may be worth a\rreward if it is returned to\rthe Magin on Subra II.
translation_zh: 話語杖\r以巨大原木挖空製成，\r話語杖是 Henresian 人團\r結的儀式象徵。若歸還\r給 Subra II 的 Magin，或\r能獲得獎賞。

original_en: Alien Meat\rThe pelt of the That Which\rStalks Blood is very rank,\rits fur steeped in a strong\rmusky odor. They Who Converse\rmight take it in exchange for\ra favor.
translation_zh: 異星獸肉\r「噬血潛行者」的毛\r皮極其腐臭，毛上浸\r著濃郁的麝香味。「交\r談者」或許願以一份\r人情換取它。

original_en: Trinket\rThis is the alien equivalent\rof cheap, plastic, jewelry.
translation_zh: 小飾品\r異星版的廉價塑膠飾品。

original_en: Levitator\rA gravitational defeat\rdevice, this levitator can be\rused to move relatively small\robjects.
translation_zh: 懸浮器\r一種抗重力裝置，此\r懸浮器可用於移動較\r小型的物體。

original_en: Matches\rMuch like the matches found\ron Earth, these matches could\rbe used to start a relatively\rsmall fire if set to a\rflammable material.
translation_zh: 火柴\r與地球上的火柴頗為\r相似，這些火柴若接\r觸易燃材料可生起一\r團小火。

original_en: Queen's Standard\rAlthough not used as a\rmilitary banner any longer,\rthe queen's standard was once\rthe battle flag of the Avian\rpeople. It is now the sole\rsymbol of the Queen of the\rAvians.
translation_zh: 王后旗幟\r雖然不再作為軍旗使\r用，王后旗幟曾是鳥\r人族的戰旗。現為鳥\r人族王后的唯一象徵。

original_en: Assassins ID\rThe identification code on\rthe card indicates that the\rbearer was from Algieba. It\rseems to implicate that\rIshtao ordered the\rassassination of princess\rJhenna.
translation_zh: 刺客證件\r卡上的識別碼顯示持\r有者來自阿吉比安。\r似乎暗示是 Ishtao 下\r令暗殺 Jhenna 公主。

original_en: Attagi Com-Code\rThe initialization code for\rthe flight controls of the\rstar cruiser Attagi.
translation_zh: Attagi 通訊碼\r星際巡航艦 Attagi 飛行\r控制的初始化代碼。

original_en: Eye Glasses\rMade of light wire and finely\rground glass, the eyeglasses\rdon't appear to have been\rmanufactured for a human\rwearer.
translation_zh: 眼鏡\r以輕質金屬絲與精磨\r玻璃製成，這副眼鏡\r看來並非為人類佩戴\r而製。

original_en: Choasqa Card 1\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
translation_zh: Choasqa 卡 1\r卡上布滿異星符號，\r你的哺乳類大腦完全\r無法解讀。

original_en: Choasqa Card 2\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
translation_zh: Choasqa 卡 2\r卡上布滿異星符號，\r你的哺乳類大腦完全\r無法解讀。

original_en: Choasqa Card 3\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
translation_zh: Choasqa 卡 3\r卡上布滿異星符號，\r你的哺乳類大腦完全\r無法解讀。

original_en: Choasqa Card 4\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
translation_zh: Choasqa 卡 4\r卡上布滿異星符號，\r你的哺乳類大腦完全\r無法解讀。

original_en: Choasqa Card 5\rThis card is covered with\ralien symbols, utterly\rindecipherable to your\rmamillian brain.
translation_zh: Choasqa 卡 5\r卡上布滿異星符號，\r你的哺乳類大腦完全\r無法解讀。

original_en: Gravity Bar\rFor reasons unknowable to\rhumans, algiebans consider\rthis device to be worth\rrisking their wealth over.\rThe only known use of a \rgravity bar is Teletrans\rwave modulation.
translation_zh: 重力棒\r基於人類無法理解的\r原因，阿吉比安人視\r此裝置為值得賭上身\r家。重力棒已知唯一\r的用途是跳躍傳送波\r調變。

original_en: Technician's ID\rAn I.D. badge that signifies\ryou as an able bodied\rtechnician.
translation_zh: 技師證\r證明你為合格技師的\r身分識別徽章。

original_en: Transformer\rA simple piece of electrical\requipment.
translation_zh: 變壓器\r一件簡單的電氣裝備。

original_en: Spare Parts\rMost of the parts in this box\rare fairly low-tech items.\rSpare parts trade is very\rgood in Sector Kornephoros.
translation_zh: 備用零件\r此盒中多數零件為相\r當低科技的物品。庫\r尼弗洛斯星區的備用\r零件交易非常興盛。

original_en: Uni-Lock\rA hand held device, the\runi-lock uses a secured\rfrequency to open infrared\rcontrolled locks. Disused in\rmost sections of the galaxy,\rmany traders in Kornephoros\rsector are still forced to\rwork with this outmoded form\rof security.
translation_zh: 萬能鎖\r一種手持裝置，萬能\r鎖使用加密頻率開啟\r紅外線控制的鎖。在\r多數星區已停用，但\r庫尼弗洛斯星區的商\r人仍被迫使用這種過\r時的安全形式。

original_en: Deed #38466\rSecured by HabStel's legal\ragents, this planetary deed\rtransfers ownership of a\rplanet in Sector Alhena to\rthe bearer.
translation_zh: 地契 #38466\r由 HabStel 的法律代理\r人擔保，此行星地契\r將 Alhena 星區一顆行\r星的所有權轉讓給持\r有人。

original_en: Mass Converter\rUsed for the conversion of\rmass to energy, this device\roperates like a large scale\rtele-trans. It is one of the\reight parts required to\rreconstruct the Centauri\rDevice.
translation_zh: 質量轉換器\r用於將質量轉換為能\r量，此裝置運作有如\r大型跳躍傳送。為重\r建半人馬裝置所需的\r八件零件之一。

original_en: Cyber Credit\rBacked by the Cyber bank on\rShadowside, this credit card\rhas a very low circulation,\rcarried usually by members of\rthe trading underworld.  It\ris commonly used by arms\rmerchants.
translation_zh: 數位信用卡\r由 Shadowside 的數位銀\r行擔保，此信用卡流\r通量極低，通常由貿\r易黑社會成員持有。\r常為軍火商使用。

original_en: Perfume\rAlthough its scent is very\runpleasant to humans, this\rperfume is very popular with\rmany alien races. Rather than\rusing antiperspirant methods,\rmany aliens simply apply this\rmixture of crushed grubs to\rthemselves.
translation_zh: 香水\r雖然氣味對人類極不\r悅人，這款香水在許\r多異星族群中非常受\r歡迎。許多異族不用\r止汗劑，而直接將此\r壓碎幼蟲混合物塗抹\r於身。

original_en: 10 Credit Card\rThis credit card is only\raccepted on Starport Kochab.\rIt is worth ten credits.
translation_zh: 10 點卡\r此信用卡僅 Kochab 太\r空港接受。價值十點。

original_en: Lozam Loaf\rGolden and full, the lozam\rloaf is made from a grain\rvery similar to wheat. A\rdesigner food, this strain\rhas great promise to end\rcases of famine in this arm\rof the galaxy.
translation_zh: Lozam 麵包\r金黃飽滿，此 Lozam 麵\r包以類似小麥的穀物\r製成。是一種改造食\r品，此品種有望終結\r此星系臂中的饑荒。

original_en: Shroud Admission\rAdmits the bearer and a small\rparty to see the fabled\rShroud of Kriq on display at\rStarport Kochab.
translation_zh: 聖紗入場券\r准許持有者及小隊參\r觀 Kochab 太空港展出\r的傳說 Kriq 聖紗。

original_en: Music Box\rRemarkably like the music\rboxes on Earth, this\rcuriosity looks as if it may\rhave been damaged.
translation_zh: 音樂盒\r與地球上的音樂盒極\r為相似，這件奇物看\r來可能受過損壞。

original_en: Particle Pak\rThis relatively small item is\ractually the ammunition\rsupply for weapons using sub-\ratomic technologies.
translation_zh: 粒子包\r這件相對小型的物品\r實為使用次原子技術\r的武器的彈藥補給。

original_en: Neutrino Cache\rHeavier than the particle\rpak, the neutrino cache\rcontains neutrinos within a\rvery special field. When used\rwith sub-atomic weapons it\rprovides a hefty ammunition\ras the neutrinos are released\rfrom the field.
translation_zh: 微中子彈匣\r比粒子包更重，微中\r子彈匣以特殊力場容\r納微中子。用於次原\r子武器時，微中子從\r力場釋出，提供強勁\r彈藥。

original_en: Power Cell\rOne of two types of\rammunition available for\rlaser weapons, a power cell\ris the standard energy supply\rfor general issue energy\rweaponry.
translation_zh: 動力電池\r雷射武器可用兩種彈\r藥之一，動力電池是\r一般配發能量武器的\r標準能源。

original_en: Energy Bank\rDesigned specifically for\rassault weapons, this energy\rbank will power heavy energy\rbursts.
translation_zh: 能量組\r專為突擊武器設計，\r此能量組可提供重型\r能量爆發所需動力。

original_en: Ammo Clip\rNine millimeter shells are\rthe standard load for this\rtype of clip, made\rspecifically to feed the\rBeretta 2043-UFS pistol. A\rsmall adjustment slide on the\rback allows for it to use\rother sizes as need arises.
translation_zh: 彈匣\r九毫米彈為此型彈匣\r的標準裝填，專為貝\r瑞塔 2043-UFS 手槍供\r彈而製。背面的小調\r節滑桿可在需要時切\r換為其他口徑。

original_en: Heavy Magazine\rDesigned to hold explosive\rtipped loads, the heavy\rmagazine can be used with a\rvariety of different\rprojectile based weapons.
translation_zh: 重型彈匣\r為裝填爆破彈頭而設\r計，重型彈匣可用於\r多種不同的投射武器。

original_en: First Aid Pak\rMade to deal with minor\rwounds only, the first aid\rpak is an invaluable aid to\ranyone venturing in dangerous\rterritories.
translation_zh: 急救包\r僅供處理輕微傷口，\r急救包對任何冒險進\r入危險地區的人都是\r無價的助手。

original_en: Trauma Kit\rEquipped with basic first aid\raccessories, this kit is also\renhanced with a small\rcellular regeneration kit.\rAlthough it rapidly depletes\rits energy supply, this item\rcan bring an injured person\rback to complete health if\rthe victim still has minimal\rlife signs.
translation_zh: 創傷急救包\r配備基本急救工具，\r此包還加裝小型細胞\r再生套件。雖會迅速\r耗盡能源，但若傷者\r尚有最低生命跡象，\r此物品能讓人恢復到\r完全健康狀態。

original_en: Shroud of Kriq\rSeized by a cult of religious\rzealots during the great\runrest that was typical of\rthe first years of Sector\rKornephoros, the Shroud of\rKriq is actually a very\rsophisticated piece of\rmedical equipment.  Knitted\rinto this fine net of\rmaterial is a high-tech\rcellular regenerator coupled\rwith an intense biofield\rgenerator. When used, it can\rbring the dead back to life,\rbut its charges are\rstartlingly limited.
translation_zh: Kriq 聖紗\r在庫尼弗洛斯星區初\r期典型大動亂中被宗\r教狂熱教團奪走，Kriq\r聖紗實為極精密的醫\r療裝備。在這片細密\r網狀材料中編織有高\r科技細胞再生器，並\r搭配強力生物場產生\r器。使用時可使死者\r復活，但其充能次數\r少得驚人。

original_en: Ulfas Cloth\rVery highly valued, this\rcloth is very highly prized,\respecially by traders dealing\rin colonial supplies.
translation_zh: Ulfas 布料\r此布料極為珍貴，深\r受處理殖民物資的商\r人重視。

original_en: Video Reader\rA small hand held device, it\ris used to scan video\rrecorded documents.  This\rparticular model seems to be\rdefective.
translation_zh: 影像讀取器\r小型手持裝置，用以\r掃描影像記錄文件。\r這一款看來有些問題。

original_en: Sonrai Sticks\rNo one is quite certain what\rare done with these strange\rsticks, but the Chytti will\roften pay great sums for\rtheir purchase.
translation_zh: Sonrai 棒\r沒人確切知道這些怪\r棒能做什麼用，但\rChytti 人常願出鉅資\r購買。

original_en: Gallery Admission\rThis ticket will allow a\rparty of visitors to enter\rthe Life Gallery Zoo in\rSector Caroli.
translation_zh: 展覽入場券\r此入場券允許一隊訪\r客進入 Caroli 星區的\r生命展覽動物園。

original_en: Slieth Egg\rAn endangered species, the\rSlieth are now under the\rEndangered Species Act of\r2031. The largest collection\rof Slieth and Slieth eggs\routside of their native\renvironment is in the Life\rGallery in Sector Caroli.
translation_zh: Slieth 蛋\r一種瀕危物種，Slieth\r現受 2031 年瀕危物種\r法保護。其原生環境\r以外最大的 Slieth 與\rSlieth 蛋蒐藏位於 Caroli\r星區的生命展覽館。

original_en: Caged Nochh\rNoted for their savage\rnature, Nochh are becoming\rincreasingly rare in natural\renvironments. This caged\rcreature would probably have\rthe best chance of survival\rif left in the care of the\rLife Gallery in Sector\rCaroli.
translation_zh: 籠中 Nochh\r以兇猛聞名，Nochh 在\r自然環境中日漸稀少。\r若把這隻籠中生物交\r給 Caroli 星區的生命\r展覽館照顧，存活機\r會最大。

original_en: Eldarin Book\rA book of alien origin.
translation_zh: Eldarin 之書\r異星起源之書。

original_en: Chytti Book\rA book of alien origin.
translation_zh: Chytti 之書\r異星起源之書。

original_en: Decorative Orb\rOn Denebola IV, a number of\rthese orbs were ordered for\rthe decoration of the\rexterior courtyard of their\rsacred temple. Although most\rhad no function other than to\rlook attractive, some were\rplaced on pedestals in order\rto open secret doors.
translation_zh: 裝飾寶珠\r在 Denebola IV，一批這\r樣的寶珠是為裝飾其\r神殿外院而訂製。雖\r然多數除了好看外無\r其他功能，但有些放\r在基座上是用來開啟\r密門。

original_en: Tractor Part\rThis grease covered\rcontraption is actually a\rvery important part in the\roperation of hydrogen\rperoxide engines. It is\rtypically found in tractors\rand harvesters like those\rfound on Alula IV.
translation_zh: 拖拉機零件\r這沾滿油脂的玩意兒\r其實是過氧化氫引擎\r運作的關鍵零件。常\r見於 Alula IV 上的拖\r拉機與收割機。

original_en: Eldarin Pot\rPainted with bright reds and\ryellows, this pot appears to\rbe painted with the\rtraditional logos of the\rancient Eldarin.
translation_zh: Eldarin 陶罐\r漆上鮮紅與亮黃色，\r此罐似乎繪有古代\rEldarin 的傳統徽記。

original_en: Ordinary Key\rRusty and brown, this\rextraordinarily large key\rlooks like it was made to fit\ran old style lock.
translation_zh: 普通鑰匙\r鏽蝕泛褐，這把異常\r大的鑰匙看似為配合\r舊式鎖具而製。

original_en: *Technical Plans*\rBlueprints, documentations\rand mathematical formulae are\rscrawled on every page on\rthese technical plans. If\rreturned to Moonbase, they\rmay have valuable technical\rinformation that will allow\rthem to upgrade your ship\rconstruction and weaponry.
translation_zh: *技術圖紙*\r每頁都潦草寫著藍圖、\r文件與數學公式。若\r帶回月球基地，當中\r可能含有寶貴的技術\r資訊，足以讓他們升\r級你的船艦建造與武\r器系統。

original_en: Fire Extinguisher\rThis device can be used to\rsnuff out flames that can\rblock or injure contact team\rmembers.
translation_zh: 滅火器\r此裝置可撲滅可能阻\r擋或傷害接觸小組成\r員的火焰。

original_en: Delta Driver\rOne of a set of three highly\rspecialized tools, the Delta\rDriver is a military device\rused in the deactivation of a\rDhoven Proximity Bomb.  When\rused in combination with its\rtwo companion tools it is\rvery safe to use.
translation_zh: 三角螺絲起子\r三件高度專業工具組\r之一，三角螺絲起子\r是用於拆除 Dhoven 近\r接炸彈的軍用裝置。\r配合另外兩件工具使\r用時十分安全。

original_en: Mirror Shard\rMade from a section of plate\rglass and backed with silver,\rthis shard looks like it has\rbeen broken off a larger\rvanity mirror.
translation_zh: 鏡子碎片\r以一塊平板玻璃製成\r並鍍銀，此碎片看似\r從更大的化妝鏡上斷\r落而來。

original_en: Flight Recorder\rTaking the familiar form of\ralien black box technology,\rthis flight recorder will\rhave the travel record of the\rCebis Alban recorded in its\rtape loops. Generally\rstarpilots are the only ones\rcapable of interpreting the\rinformation on them.
translation_zh: 飛行記錄器\r採異星黑盒技術中熟\r悉的型態，此飛行記\r錄器的磁帶迴圈中應\r記錄著 Cebis Alban 號\r的航行記錄。通常只\r有星際領航員能解讀\r其中的資訊。

original_en: Alien Medipak\rDue to the nature of the\rmaterials included in this\rmedical pack, it would be\rhighly inadvisable to\radminister these materials on\ra human being.  The markings\ron the package denote it as\rbeing intended for Cebesians.
translation_zh: 異星醫療包\r鑒於此醫療包所含物\r質的性質，極不建議\r將其用於人類。包裝\r上的標示顯示此物為\rCebesians 族所用。

original_en: Mini Aid Paks\rAlthough most of the medical\rsupplies in this pack are\rincompatible with human\rbiology, some of them should\rwork if correctly applied.
translation_zh: 迷你急救包\r雖然此包內多數醫療\r用品與人類生理不相\r容，但有些若正確使\r用應仍有效。

original_en: Alien Doll\rThis object is an alien\rplaything, designed in all\rprobability for a young\rCebesian.
translation_zh: 異星娃娃\r此物為異星玩物，極\r可能是為幼小的\rCebesian 設計。

original_en: Leader's Stone\rThe dark blue stone inset in\rthis piece of jewelry is the\rtraditional symbol of the\rleader of the Cebesians.\rAlthough it has little\rmonetary value, those who\rwear it are treated with\rutmost respect by other\rraces.
translation_zh: 領袖之石\r此飾品上鑲嵌的深藍\r色寶石是 Cebesians 領袖\r的傳統象徵。雖無多\r少貨幣價值，但佩戴\r者會受到其他族群最\r崇高的敬意。

original_en: Android Tool\rIf used on a damaged android,\rthis remote control can dump\rthe android's last thoughts\rin audio form. This tool is\rvery useful when information\ris needed from heavily\rdamaged androids.
translation_zh: 人造人工具\r若用於受損的人造人，\r此遙控器可將該人造\r人最後的思緒以音訊\r形式輸出。當需從嚴\r重損壞的人造人身上\r取得情報時極為實用。

original_en: Harvest Key\rThis pass key will unlock the\rdoor to the Control Deck on\rAlula IV.
translation_zh: 豐收鑰匙\r此通行鑰匙可開啟\rAlula IV 控制甲板的門。

original_en: Sack Of Lozam\rHeavier than it looks, this\rsack of lozam is streaked\rwith brownish slicks of\rlubricant created by leaky\rmechgrippers.
translation_zh: 一袋 Lozam\r比看起來還重，這袋\rlozam 上沾著漏油機械\r爪留下的褐色潤滑油\r痕跡。

original_en: Stone\rA fairly common kind of\rstone, this rock is for the\rmost part featureless.
translation_zh: 石頭\r相當常見的石頭，這\r塊石頭大致毫無特徵。

original_en: Ysaf Note\rScrawled hastily in the hand\rof the chief controller on\rAlula IV,this note is\rintended for the Eldarin\rleader, Ysaf, on Denebola IV.
translation_zh: Ysaf 字條\r由 Alula IV 的首席管制\r員匆匆潦草寫下，此字\r條是寫給 Denebola IV 的\rEldarin 領袖 Ysaf。

original_en: Dhoven Deed\rThis deed has been heavily\rencrypted by a Dhoven legate\rbut does not bear the proper\rfinal seal of approval by the\rSecretary of Sector Affairs.
translation_zh: Dhoven 地契\r此地契已由 Dhoven 特\r使重度加密，但未蓋\r星區事務秘書長的最\r終核准印章。

original_en: Numismat Deed\rThis deed, heavily encrypted\rby a Dhoven legate, appears\rto be in order. It bears a\rmark that urges immediate\rdelivery to the Dhoven\rStation at Hyades.
translation_zh: Numismat 地契\r此地契經 Dhoven 特使\r重度加密，看來合規。\r上面有一個標記，敦\r促立刻送往 Hyades 的\rDhoven 站點。

original_en: Krupp Shields\rMade of a superdense\rmaterial, the Krupp Shields\rwill prevent radiation leaks\rthat are common with large\rscale engines. It will be\rneeded at Moonbase for the\rreconstruction of the\rCentauri Device.
translation_zh: 克魯伯護盾\r由超高密度材料製成，\r克魯伯護盾可防止大\r型引擎常見的輻射洩\r漏。月球基地將需要\r它來重建半人馬裝置。

original_en: Planet Deed\rThe deed, though properly\rprocessed, is utterly\rworthless.  It is a deed for\ra dead and mineral poor\rplanet in Sector Alhena.
translation_zh: 行星地契\r此地契雖手續正確，\r卻完全無價值。是\rAlhena 星區中一顆死\r寂且礦藏匱乏行星的\r地契。

original_en: Fixit Kit\rA Packet of tech tools\rdesigned to repair armor that\rhas been damaged in the\rcourse of duty. The\rcomplexity of the tools would\rsuggest that a character with\ra higher Item Repair ability\rwill get better results from\rthe kit.
translation_zh: 修補工具包\r一組科技工具，專為\r修復任務中受損的護\r甲而設計。工具的複\r雜性顯示道具修復能\r力較高的角色能從此\r組得到更好的效果。

original_en: Cyber Boots\rA combination of gravitic and\rrobotic technology, the cyber\rboots permit their wearer to\rjump twice as far as before.
translation_zh: 數位靴\r結合重力與機器人技\r術，數位靴允許穿戴\r者跳得比原本遠兩倍。

original_en: Rubber Stamp\rFound in beaurocracies all\racross the universe, the\rrubber stamp is the friend of\rpaper-pushers everywhere.\rThis particular stamp bears\rthe seal of the Numistat of\rAlhena sector.
translation_zh: 橡皮章\r在宇宙各處的官僚體\r系都能見到，橡皮章\r是各地紙上行政者的\r好友。這枚特定印章\r帶有 Alhena 星區\rNumistat 的印璽。

original_en: Alien Regen\rReminiscent of the chemicals\rfound in some zombie movies,\rthis stange spray-on mist\rwill literaly bring the dead\rback to life.  Unfortunately,\rit only makes dead humans\rtwitch a little.  Remember\rthat most aliens don't like\rgetting killed, and may still\rbe a little upset when you\rwake them from the dead.
translation_zh: 異星再生劑\r令人聯想到某些殭屍\r電影中的化學物，這\r種怪異噴霧真的能令\r死者復活。可惜，對\r死去的人類只能讓他\r抽搐一下。請記住多\r數異族不喜歡被殺，\r你把他們從死中喚醒\r後，或許還會有點不\r爽。

original_en: Ship Plans\rA technical readout of\rsystems designed for a space\rship.
translation_zh: 船艦圖紙\r為太空船設計之系統\r的技術讀本。

original_en: Last Stanza\rThe phrases written on the\rscrap of paper appear to be\rpart of a poem:  Replace my\rname And Secundus fear The\rrevenge of Conciere!  So now\rI claim Defender Last And\rSecundus learn to fear!
translation_zh: 末段詩節\r寫於碎紙上的字句似\r為一首詩的片段：替\r換吾名，令 Secundus 畏\r懼 Conciere 之復仇！\r我今宣告守護者最末\r位，Secundus 學會懼怕！

original_en: Used Eyeballs\rThese cybernetic eyeballs\rrequire cybernetic sockets\rto function properly.
translation_zh: 用過的眼球\r這些機械眼球需要機\r械眼窩才能正常運作。

original_en: Jar of Uru\rA clear jar filled with a\rsemi-solid jell not\raltogether unlike jam. The \rlid of the jar bears the mark\rof the Ethnys Queen.
translation_zh: Uru 罐\r透明的罐子裝著一種\r半固態果凍，類似果\r醬。罐蓋上印著 Ethnys\r女王的徽記。

original_en: Sphere of Themi\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
translation_zh: Themi 之球\r一顆珍珠般的球體，\r觸感冰涼。掃描判定\r可能來自 Ankaq 星區。

original_en: Golden Trident\rA golden trident with a\rwooden shaft. The artifact\rappears to be ceremonial.\rAnalysis of the metal reveals\rit to be from the Ankaq\rsector.
translation_zh: 金色三叉戟\r金色三叉戟配木製柄。\r此文物似為儀式用。\r金屬成分分析顯示來\r自 Ankaq 星區。

original_en: Coral Instrument\rA delicately crafted musical \rinstrument, made of coral.\rThe design is completely\ralien.
translation_zh: 珊瑚樂器\r精雕細琢的樂器，以\r珊瑚製成。設計完全\r異於人類。

original_en: Grav Buoy\rA black, rectangular box full\rof wires with a focusing\rmechanism on one end. The\rmetal of the box is unique to\rthe Zaurak sector.
translation_zh: 重力浮標\r黑色長方盒，內部布\r滿電線，一端有聚焦\r機制。盒子的金屬為\rZaurak 星區特有。

original_en: Wet Suit\rA diving suit with self\rcontained breathing device.\rMuch like an advanced version\rof standard S.C.U.B.A. gear.
translation_zh: 潛水服\r附自給式呼吸裝置的\r潛水服。類似標準\rS.C.U.B.A. 裝備的進階\r版本。

original_en: Fake Sphere\rA pearl-like sphere. Scans\rdetermine the material of the\rsphere to be an artificial\rrepresentation of another \rsubstance found in the Ankaq \rsystem.
translation_zh: 假球體\r珍珠般的球體。掃描\r判定此球體材質為人\r造，模仿 Ankaq 星系\r中另一種物質的外觀。

original_en: Anti-Mat Grenade\rA powerful grenade.
translation_zh: 反物質手榴彈\r強力手榴彈。

original_en: Mind Net Key\rA thin plastic card with a\rholograph of the word\r'MindNet' on its face.
translation_zh: 心網鑰\r薄塑膠卡，正面有「\rMindNet」字樣的全像圖。

original_en: Control Spike\rA long, thin silver spike\rwith a diamond tip. The tip\ris cut in an intricate shape\rthat suggests its use may be\ras a key.
translation_zh: 控制針\r細長銀色針狀物，尖\r端為鑽石。尖端切成\r複雜形狀，暗示其用\r途可能是鑰匙。

original_en: Control Crystals\rTranslucent crystals grown in\rstrange formations.\rSpectrograph shows the\rcrystals to contain trace \relements found on Alnasl 1.
translation_zh: 控制水晶\r半透明的水晶以奇異\r結構生長。光譜儀顯\r示水晶含有 Alnasl 1 上\r發現的微量元素。

original_en: P.C. Strandware\rA vial of genetic material\rsuspended in fluid. The vial\ris labeled 'Proconsul.'
translation_zh: P.C. 鏈件\r一小瓶懸浮於液體中\r的基因物質。瓶上標\r示「Proconsul」。

original_en: Regular Strandware\rA vial of genetic material\rsuspended in fluid. The vial\ris labeled 'Standard Ominar.'
translation_zh: 標準鏈件\r一小瓶懸浮於液體中\r的基因物質。瓶上標\r示「標準 Ominar」。

original_en: Gold Sphere\rA golden globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
translation_zh: 金色球體\r金色球體。輻射光譜\r儀判定其金屬來自\rAlrai 星系。

original_en: Platinum Sphere\rA platinum globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
translation_zh: 白金球體\r白金球體。輻射光譜\r儀判定其金屬來自\rAlrai 星系。

original_en: Bronze Sphere\rA bronze globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
translation_zh: 青銅球體\r青銅球體。輻射光譜\r儀判定其金屬來自\rAlrai 星系。

original_en: Invisible Idiot\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Invisible Idiot written\rin the language of the\rUtrece.
translation_zh: 隱形傻瓜\r平塑膠卡，上面以\rUtrece 語寫著「隱形\r傻瓜」字樣。

original_en: Marathon Victory\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Marathon Victory\rwritten in the language of\rthe Utrece.
translation_zh: 馬拉松勝利\r平塑膠卡，上面以\rUtrece 語寫著「馬拉\r松勝利」字樣。

original_en: Blind Faith\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Blind Faith written in\rthe language of the Utrece.
translation_zh: 盲目信仰\r平塑膠卡，上面以\rUtrece 語寫著「盲目\r信仰」字樣。

original_en: Virtual Reality\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Virtual Reality written\rin the language of the\rUtrece.
translation_zh: 虛擬實境\r平塑膠卡，上面以\rUtrece 語寫著「虛擬\r實境」字樣。

original_en: Cold Reason\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Cold Reason written in\rthe language of the Utrece.
translation_zh: 冷酷理性\r平塑膠卡，上面以\rUtrece 語寫著「冷酷\r理性」字樣。

original_en: Sphere of Rhys\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
translation_zh: Rhys 之球\r一顆珍珠般的球體，\r觸感冰涼。掃描判定\r可能來自 Ankaq 星區。

original_en: Sphere of Awa\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
translation_zh: Awa 之球\r一顆珍珠般的球體，\r觸感冰涼。掃描判定\r可能來自 Ankaq 星區。

original_en: Silver Sphere\rA silver globe.\rRadiospectrograph identifies\rthe metal as coming from the\rAlrai system.
translation_zh: 銀色球體\r銀色球體。輻射光譜\r儀判定其金屬來自\rAlrai 星系。

original_en: Utrecian Key\rA key.
translation_zh: Utrece 鑰匙\r鑰匙。

original_en: Mintap\rA small box with three wires \rdangling from one end. The \rconnecters on the ends of the\rwires would suggest this to\rbe some kind of cybernetic\rdata module.
translation_zh: Mintap\r小盒子，一端垂著三\r條電線。線端的連接\r器顯示此物為某種數\r位資料模組。

original_en: Commnet\rA container with twenty\rreceptacles, or jacks, on\ropposite sides. The device\rappears to be a \rcommunications networking \rstation.
translation_zh: 通訊網\r一個容器，兩側共有\r二十個插座或插孔。\r此裝置看似為通訊網\r路站點。

original_en: Tschi Tai Pin\rAn identification badge.
translation_zh: Tschi Tai 別針\r身分識別徽章。

original_en: Sphere of Harmon\rA pearl-like sphere, cold to\rthe touch. Scans determine\rpossible origins in the Ankaq\rsector.
translation_zh: Harmon 之球\r一顆珍珠般的球體，\r觸感冰涼。掃描判定\r可能來自 Ankaq 星區。

original_en: Datatape\rA cartridge somewhat like a \rcassette, with magnetic tape\rwound around a graphite core.
translation_zh: 資料帶\r類似卡帶的匣式儲存\r裝置，磁帶纏繞在石\r墨芯上。

original_en: Death Threat\rA formal letter addressed to\rMovrin Sepo from Wiretap.
translation_zh: 死亡威脅\r一封由 Wiretap 寄給\rMovrin Sepo 的正式信函。

original_en: Hataphas Gem\rA gem that looks rather like\ran eyeball. Analysis of the\rmaterial of the gem suggests\rit may originate from Izar 2\rin the Izar sector.
translation_zh: Hataphas 寶石\r一顆相當像眼球的寶\r石。材質分析顯示可\r能源自 Izar 星區的\rIzar 2。

original_en: N.I.C.T.U.\rA mechanical device that\rlooks exactly like one of the\rpieces found on the plans for\rthe Centauri device.
translation_zh: N.I.C.T.U.\r一個機械裝置，外觀\r與半人馬裝置圖紙上\r的某個零件一模一樣。

original_en: Weird Science\rA flat plastic card with the\rwords Weird Science written\rin the language of the\rUtrece.
translation_zh: 怪異科學\r平塑膠卡，上面以\rUtrece 語寫著「怪異\r科學」字樣。

original_en: Star Stone\rA leather pouch containing\r107 sparkling stones. The\rmaterial of the stones is\rknown to be unique to the\rIzar system.
translation_zh: 星石\r裝著 107 顆閃亮石頭\r的皮袋。已知此石頭\r的材質為 Izar 星系所\r特有。

original_en: Jammer\rA small, electro-mechanical\rdevice with a small antenna\rprotruding from one end and a\rred dial in the middle of a\rpalm grip.
translation_zh: 干擾器\r一個小型機電裝置，\r一端伸出小天線，掌\r握把中央有紅色旋鈕。

original_en: Letters\rStationary with writing that\rappears to be in some sort of\rcode.
translation_zh: 信件\r一張信紙，上面似乎\r以某種密碼書寫。

original_en: Official Papers\rIdentification papers.
translation_zh: 官方文件\r身分證件。

original_en: Algo Cam\rA mechanical device that\rlooks exactly like one of the\rpieces found on the plans for\rthe Centauri device.
translation_zh: 阿戈凸輪\r一個機械裝置，外觀\r與半人馬裝置圖紙上\r的某個零件一模一樣。

original_en: ISC Pin\rAn identification badge.
translation_zh: ISC 別針\r身分識別徽章。

original_en: Funny Hat\rA workers cap with a brim\rthat goes all the way around\rit.
translation_zh: 滑稽帽\r一頂工人帽，帽簷環\r繞一圈。

original_en: Maint Card\rA thin plastic card with\rholographic code printed on\rthe surface.
translation_zh: 維護卡\r薄塑膠卡，表面印有\r全像碼。

original_en: Nav Beacon\rA small cylindrical shaped\rdevice with flashing lights\ron its ends.
translation_zh: 導航信標\r小型圓柱狀裝置，兩\r端有閃爍燈光。

original_en: ID Case\rA wooden box with a bottle of\rreddish liquid. Scans\rindicate the liquid to be a\rdistillate of fruits\rindigenous to Vindemiatrix in\rthe Izar sector.
translation_zh: 證件盒\r木盒內裝一瓶紅色液\r體。掃描顯示液體為\rIzar 星區 Vindemiatrix\r原生水果的蒸餾液。

original_en: Cevitic Balancer\rA clear plastic globe with\rsmaller globes floating\rinside. Appears to be part of\ra transport beam device.
translation_zh: Cevitic 平衡器\r透明塑膠球體，內部\r漂浮著較小球體。似\r為傳送光束裝置的一\r部分。

original_en: Optical Key\rA thin plastic card with a \rholographic code printed on\rthe surface. The holographic\ris of Eth/Muni symbols.
translation_zh: 光學鑰匙\r薄塑膠卡，表面印有\r全像碼。全像圖為\rEth/Muni 符號。
